block before 1500/1000em
section 1 number "1"
  text "Alphabet Styles"
para
  text "The text-sourced alphabets each set the plain base letter in a text family: upright "
  formula inline "\\mathrm {A}"
    ord:alpha:rm{ord:𝐴}
  text ", bold "
  formula inline "\\mathbf {B}"
    ord:alpha:bf{ord:𝐵}
  text ", italic "
  formula inline "\\mathit {C}"
    ord:alpha:it{ord:𝐶}
  text ", sans "
  formula inline "\\mathsf {D}"
    ord:alpha:sf{ord:𝐷}
  text ", and mono "
  formula inline "\\mathtt {E}"
    ord:alpha:tt{ord:𝐸}
  text " sit inline. A styled digit keeps its family too, as in "
  formula inline "\\mathbf {7}"
    ord:alpha:bf{ord:7}
  text ", and a styled scalar nests inside a script in "
  formula inline "x_{\\mathsf {k}} + y^{\\mathbf {2}}"
    ord:𝑥_{ord:alpha:sf{ord:𝑘}} bin:+ ord:𝑦^{ord:alpha:bf{ord:2}}
  text "."
